hints.title: Per-Car Aggregates
hints.text: Calculate the total fee paid and total duration in minutes across all lots for each car.

hints.title: Per-Lot Duration
hints.text: Calculate the duration spent by each car in each parking lot.

hints.title: Most Time Lot Ranking
hints.text: Rank lots per car by total duration in descending order using ROW_NUMBER or ranking.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
WITH CarTotals AS (
    SELECT 
        car_id,
        SUM(fee_paid) AS total_fee_paid,
        SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, entry_time, exit_time)) AS total_duration
    FROM ParkingTransactions
    GROUP BY car_id
),
LotTotals AS (
    SELECT 
        car_id,
        lot_id,
        SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, entry_time, exit_time)) AS lot_duration,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY car_id 
            ORDER BY SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, entry_time, exit_time)) DESC, lot_id ASC
        ) AS rnk
    FROM ParkingTransactions
    GROUP BY car_id, lot_id
)
SELECT 
    c.car_id,
    c.total_fee_paid,
    ROUND(c.total_fee_paid * 60.0 / c.total_duration, 2) AS avg_hourly_fee,
    l.lot_id AS most_time_lot
FROM CarTotals c
JOIN LotTotals l 
  ON c.car_id = l.car_id AND l.rnk = 1
ORDER BY c.car_id ASC;
```

complexity.notes: Grouping and window ranking take O(n log n).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Cannot directly join without aggregating per car and per lot first.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: CTEs isolate car totals and ranked lot times.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use CTEs and window ROW_NUMBER to identify the primary parking lot.

WITH CarTotals AS (
    SELECT 
        car_id,
        SUM(fee_paid) AS total_fee_paid,
        SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (exit_time - entry_time)) / 60) AS total_duration
    FROM ParkingTransactions
    GROUP BY car_id
),
LotTotals AS (
    SELECT 
        car_id,
        lot_id,
        SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (exit_time - entry_time)) / 60) AS lot_duration,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY car_id 
            ORDER BY SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (exit_time - entry_time)) / 60) DESC, lot_id ASC
        ) AS rnk
    FROM ParkingTransactions
    GROUP BY car_id, lot_id
)
SELECT 
    c.car_id,
    c.total_fee_paid,
    ROUND((c.total_fee_paid * 60.0 / c.total_duration)::numeric, 2) AS avg_hourly_fee,
    l.lot_id AS most_time_lot
FROM CarTotals c
JOIN LotTotals l 
  ON c.car_id = l.car_id AND l.rnk = 1
ORDER BY c.car_id ASC;

import pandas as pd

def calculate_parking_fees_and_duration(parking_transactions: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if parking_transactions.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame(columns=['car_id', 'total_fee_paid', 'avg_hourly_fee', 'most_time_lot'])
    
    parking_transactions['entry_time'] = pd.to_datetime(parking_transactions['entry_time'])
    parking_transactions['exit_time'] = pd.to_datetime(parking_transactions['exit_time'])
    parking_transactions['duration'] = (parking_transactions['exit_time'] - parking_transactions['entry_time']).dt.total_seconds() / 60
    
    car_totals = parking_transactions.groupby('car_id').agg(
        total_fee_paid=('fee_paid', 'sum'),
        total_duration=('duration', 'sum')
    ).reset_index()
    car_totals['avg_hourly_fee'] = (car_totals['total_fee_paid'] * 60.0 / car_totals['total_duration']).round(2)
    
    lot_durations = parking_transactions.groupby(['car_id', 'lot_id'])['duration'].sum().reset_index()
    lot_durations = lot_durations.sort_values(by=['car_id', 'duration', 'lot_id'], ascending=[True, False, True])
    most_time = lot_durations.drop_duplicates(subset=['car_id']).rename(columns={'lot_id': 'most_time_lot'})
    
    res = car_totals.merge(most_time[['car_id', 'most_time_lot']], on='car_id')
    return res[['car_id', 'total_fee_paid', 'avg_hourly_fee', 'most_time_lot']].sort_values(by='car_id').reset_index(drop=True)
